decisions.statement: Descent is walked down the reverse of `extends-type` read beside each page.
A page type is under itself.
Every page type is under `page`, so that descent is every page type filed.
A page type reaching no parent it names is under no other page type.
A caller with the index as its change leaves that index is answered from that.
A caller names the reading and nothing more.
A slug two page types carry is under every type either names.

definition: which page types are under a given page type
